oi_delta_clusters.note_en: Contract-by-contract open-interest change between the 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-10 chain snapshots. Counts of contracts added or closed at each strike — not a direction call. The two snapshots are 2 trading sessions apart, not consecutive, so the change covers that whole stretch. Per-strike chain snapshots begin 2026-06-15, so this record is still short.
oi_delta_clusters.note_zh: 2026-08-06 与 2026-08-10 两次期权链快照之间逐张合约的未平仓量变化，显示各行权价新增或平掉的合约数量，不代表方向判断。两次快照相隔 2 个交易日，并不相邻，因此变化涵盖这整段时间。逐行权价期权链快照自 2026-06-15 起累积，记录仍然很短。

regime_passport.note: dealer long-call/short-put sign is an unobservable assumption; single-name gamma regime is a near-constant product attribute, not a time-varying signal (validator MIN_PER_BUCKET structurally unreachable)

reliability.note: Direction soft — sign not NBBO-confirmed. All levels are descriptive maps, not forecasts.

wall_persistence.basis_en: This level is the heaviest open interest in the snapshot source's full contract list. The board's own call and put walls are dollar-gamma levels taken from a narrower window of a different chain source, so the two often land on different strikes.
wall_persistence.basis_zh: 此水平取自快照来源完整合约列表中未平仓量最重的行权价。本板块自身的看涨/看跌墙是另一个期权链来源、在更窄区间内计算的美元 Gamma 水平，因此两者经常落在不同的行权价上。

call_side.note_en: The heaviest call-side open interest has sat at 575 for the last 2 of 6 stored chain snapshots. Open-interest size is a count of contracts, not a dealer position.
call_side.note_zh: 看涨未平仓量最重的行权价，在已存储的 6 次期权链快照中，最近 2 次落在 575。未平仓量是合约数量，不是做市商持仓。

put_side.note_en: The heaviest put-side open interest has sat at 400 for the last 1 of 6 stored chain snapshots. Open-interest size is a count of contracts, not a dealer position.
put_side.note_zh: 看跌未平仓量最重的行权价，在已存储的 6 次期权链快照中，最近 1 次落在 400。未平仓量是合约数量，不是做市商持仓。

net_gex_pctile.note_en: Today's net dealer gamma is above every one of this name's own stored daily readings (28 trading days, 2026-06-16 to 2026-08-10). The record is short, so read it as a rough placement.
net_gex_pctile.note_zh: 今日净做市商 Gamma 高于该标的自身每一天的记录（28 个交易日，2026-06-16 至 2026-08-10）。记录较短，只能作为粗略定位。
